items.title: 5 Best Memory Stocks to Buy According to Billionaires

items.title: Q3 Earnings Update: Broad-Based Growth, Key Sector Outliers, and What's Ahead for Q4
items.summary: The bulk of the Q3 earnings season is over, with results from roughly 12% of S&P 500 members remaining. Including the still-to-come reports, Q3 earnings are on pace to grow +28.4% year-over-year on +14.4% higher revenues, the 8th straight quarter of double-digit earnings growth for the index.

items.title: Lam Research Soars 9% on $25 Billion Buyback as Chip Stocks Rebound From Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLam Research shares jumped 9% today after its board approved a $25 billion buyback, outpacing ASML and the other chip-equipment makers in the rebound. Lam had no other news, so the buyback is the clearest reason for the extra gain, and it’s a strong vote of confidence.
